component.name: Mie Survival
component.summary: Voxel survival sandbox with crafting, hunger and multiplayer

description.p: Mie Survival is a lightweight voxel sandbox focused on gathering resources, crafting, exploration, building and survival. This Linux package includes the Survival v0.1 gameplay systems, including hunger, food, armour and the expanded early-game crafting progression.
First Flatpak-ready Linux build based on Survival v0.1.
